instruction: Retarget the florist's demonstrated reach, grasp, flower transport, scissors use, insertion, release, and retraction into one silver humanoid robot while preserving the real captured flower-arrangement scene and the exact source timing.
embodiment: the exact coherent silver humanoid robot shown in the reference image, with two articulated five-finger hands, stable metallic material, and unchanged body identity

objects.description: the source flowers and individually visible stems, retaining their original color, count, geometry, depth ordering, and per-frame motion
persistence_invariants: Each manipulated stem remains the same material instance throughout the timeline.
A flower moves only with the demonstrated hand interaction or its demonstrated support response.
No flower or stem freezes, teleports, duplicates, disappears, or merges with the robot.

objects.description: one black-handled stainless-steel florist scissors with two handle rings, two blades, and one rigid pivot
persistence_invariants: Exactly one scissors exists during its source interval.
The robot fingers remain visually threaded through the handle rings while the tool is held.
The pivot remains attached to the right hand and the blades preserve the source opening angle.

objects.description: the original vase and its support relationship with placed stems
persistence_invariants: The vase geometry, pose, color, and support surface remain source-locked.
Inserted stems preserve the demonstrated vase occlusion and support ordering.

phases.instruction: Establish one stable robot identity and preserve the untouched initial arrangement.
Follow the source wrist and finger trajectory toward the selected stem without moving it early.
Close on the demonstrated stem at the source time and retain the same grasp side.
Carry the same held stem along the demonstrated trajectory with no hand-object lag.
Reproduce the demonstrated insertion and support transition while keeping the vase immutable.
Carry and articulate the one rigid scissors along the exact source tool trajectory; preserve both rings, both blades, and the pivot.
Preserve the late demonstrated hand-flower contacts and continuous stem response during insertion.
Open the hand at the demonstrated time and leave the flower supported exactly as in the source.
Retract along the source path while preserving the final flower arrangement and robot identity.

scene_invariants: Preserve the source camera trajectory, timing, table, wall, vase, lighting, and every background pixel outside the demonstrated actor region.
Preserve source object count, object motion, occlusion order, and contact-side depth ordering.
Do not add people, robot parts, tools, flowers, text, cuts, or camera motion.
Do not smooth away demonstrated hand, tool, flower, or stem motion.
